# The New School Exeter

> The New School Exeter provides independent pre-prep education in Devon alongside comprehensive technical tutorials covering enterprise software, data science, and programming languages.

The New School Exeter is an independent pre-prep school in Devon, England. The site also hosts an extensive collection of technical tutorials covering enterprise systems like SAP, programming languages including Python and Scala, and data analytics tools.

## Key Topics

- SAP
- Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
- Python
- Scala
- Apache Spark
- Web Scraping
- Machine Learning
- Data Analytics
- SAP S/4HANA
- ABAP Programming
- Business Intelligence
- Data Extraction
- Functional Programming
- Big Data Processing
- Independent Education

## Core Pages

- [The New School Exeter – Independent Pre-Prep Education in Devon](https://thenewschoolexeter.co.uk): Homepage for The New School Exeter independent pre-prep school in Devon
- [Scholars Tutorials: Comprehensive Guides for Academic Excellence](https://thenewschoolexeter.co.uk/2026/03/scholars-tutorials.html): Scholars Tutorials expert-led guides for academic learning and excellence
